title: Be likely to, be bound to, be about to
summary: Nói khả năng xảy ra: be likely/unlikely to (có thể/khó), be bound to (chắc chắn), be about to (sắp), be due to (theo lịch).

dialogue.en: Is the new café opening this week?
dialogue.vi: Quán cà phê mới tuần này khai trương à?

dialogue.en: It [['s due to]] open on Friday.
dialogue.vi: Theo kế hoạch thứ Sáu khai trương.

dialogue.en: It [['s bound to]] be busy. Everyone's talking about it.
dialogue.vi: Chắc chắn sẽ đông. Ai cũng bàn về nó.

dialogue.en: Yes, there [['s likely to]] be a long queue.
dialogue.vi: Ừ, chắc sẽ phải xếp hàng dài.

dialogue.en: Let's go early, then. Oh, the rain [['s about to]] start.
dialogue.vi: Vậy đi sớm nhé. Ồ, trời sắp mưa rồi.

sections.heading: Be likely / unlikely to + V
sections.rule: **be likely to + V** = có khả năng; **be unlikely to + V** = khó có khả năng. Cũng nói **It is likely that + mệnh đề**.

examples.en: Prices [[are likely to]] rise next year.
examples.vi: Giá có khả năng tăng năm tới.

examples.en: He [['s unlikely to]] come before ten.
examples.vi: Khó mà anh ấy đến trước mười giờ.

examples.en: [[It is likely that]] the shop will close.
examples.vi: Có khả năng cửa hàng sẽ đóng cửa.
examples.why: It is likely that + mệnh đề.

check.prompt: It's very cloudy. It's ___ rain later.

sections.heading: Be bound to + V
sections.rule: **be bound to + V** = **chắc chắn sẽ** (người nói rất tin).

examples.en: You [['re bound to]] pass. You studied so hard.
examples.vi: Bạn chắc chắn đỗ. Bạn học chăm thế mà.

examples.en: It [['s bound to]] be crowded on Saturday.
examples.vi: Thứ Bảy chắc chắn sẽ đông.

check.prompt: Don't worry, she's ___ find a job soon.

sections.heading: Be about to, be due to
sections.rule: **be about to + V** = sắp (ngay bây giờ). **be due to + V** = theo lịch / kế hoạch sẽ.

examples.en: Hurry! The bus [['s about to]] leave.
examples.vi: Nhanh lên! Xe buýt sắp chạy.

examples.en: The baby [['s due to]] arrive in March.
examples.vi: Em bé dự sinh vào tháng Ba.

examples.en: The meeting [[was due to]] start at two.
examples.vi: Cuộc họp lẽ ra bắt đầu lúc hai giờ.

check.prompt: The plane is ___ land in five minutes.
check.explain: Sắp xảy ra ngay → about to.

mistakes.right: The film is about to start.

mistakes.wrong: The train is due arrive at five.
mistakes.right: The train is due to arrive at five.

exercises.prompt: He always forgets. He's ___ forget again.
Sit down, the show is ___ begin.
The new bridge is ___ open next month.
Câu nào nghĩa là KHÓ xảy ra?
There ___ be a lot of traffic at five.
answers: is likely to
's likely to

exercises.prompt: We were ___ leave when it started to rain.
answers: about to

exercises.prompt: The report ___ be finished by Monday.
answers: is due to
's due to
exercises.explain: Theo kế hoạch → be due to.

exercises.prompt: You're ___ to like this film. Everyone loves it.
answers: bound

exercises.vi: Có khả năng ngày mai trời mưa.

exercises.sentence: It is bound to raining tonight.
answers: It is bound to rain tonight.

exercises.sentence: He is likely that he will be late.
answers: He is likely to be late.
exercises.explain: Chủ ngữ người → is likely to + V.

exercises.sentence: The concert is due start at eight.
answers: The concert is due to start at eight.

exercises.vi: Anh ấy khó mà đến đúng giờ.
answers: He is unlikely to arrive on time.
He's unlikely to arrive on time.
He is unlikely to come on time.
He's unlikely to come on time.
He is unlikely to be on time.
He's unlikely to be on time.

exercises.vi: Chuyến bay dự kiến hạ cánh lúc 9 giờ.
answers: The flight is due to land at 9.
The flight is due to land at nine.
The flight is due to arrive at 9.
The flight is due to arrive at nine.
The flight is expected to land at 9.
The flight is expected to land at nine.
